title: Reset a Suspense boundary with a key

slides.say: During a Transition, React keeps old content visible. But going from Alice’s profile to Bob’s, you want a fallback, not Alice’s bio.
Give it a key based on the profile id. A different key means different content.

slides.text: New key → React resets the boundary and shows the fallback.
slides.say: With a new key, React resets the Suspense boundary during navigation, and shows the fallback instead of the previous user.

slides.text: Put the key on the boundary or any component above it. Good routers do this for you.
slides.say: The key can go on the boundary itself or a component above it. Suspense integrated routers should do this automatically.
